title: 第11章 匪徒凶残第12章 凶兽落尘
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
“小兄弟，我饿了，也馋了。
卖给我呗，这钱给你。”
李富贵忍受不住香味的诱惑，说话很实在。
边说边从怀里掏出一个银元宝，递给落尘。
银元宝足有五两重，可以买下一头牛了。
“一只鸡一个银元宝，只卖两只。”
落尘看着银元宝，终于开口。
背篓里只有几块铜板了，换些银两也不错，离凌霄宗还有一个月的路程，有了银两可以买马，能走快一些。
“好，好。
剩那半只烤兔子卖不？我也给你一个元宝。”
李富贵连忙又掏出两个元宝。
落尘默默接过三个元宝，把两只烧鸡和半个烤兔子递过去。
烧鸡的香味实在太诱人，李富贵也顾不得烫，张嘴就啃。
“好吃，好吃，肥而不腻，唇齿留香，唇齿留香。”
李富贵一边啃，一边赞叹，嘴里有肉，话语含糊不清。
“败家子。
特么的，三个元宝就买了两只烧鸡半个烤兔，蠢蠢的败家子。”
两个保镖心里骂道，却不敢声张。
李勇见怪不怪，没有理会李富贵的表现。
饶有兴趣的打量起缠在落尘胳膊上的小白蛇。

“虽然看不出等级，但这小白蛇肯定是一只灵兽。
能带灵宠的人都不简单。”
李勇暗忖。
他曾经在一个小宗门修炼过，不过灵根太杂，练气一重后多年没有进展，被打发下山帮宗门做生意了。
虽然只是炼气一重，但耳濡目染，眼光还是有的。
李富贵狼吞虎咽地啃完了一只烧鸡，也注意到小白蛇。
“兄弟，这小蛇卖给我吧，我出五个元宝，不，出十个元宝。”
“不卖，多少钱也不卖！”
落尘有些愠怒，一口回绝。
小白蛇似乎听懂了对话，竖起脑袋，眼露凶光，瞪着李富贵。
“小兄弟，冒昧地问一下，你是宗门里的人吧？”
李勇想缓解尴尬的气氛。
“不是，我还想找宗门呢。”
落尘下意识答道。
“你找宗门，去凌霄宗啊，那可是大宗门，一个月后招收新弟子。
我就是去参加考核的，要不咱们一起去？你的吃住费用我都包了。”
没等李勇开口，李富贵抢先说道。
content_en:
"Little brother, I'm hungry and greedy.
Sell it to me and I'll give you the money. "
Li Fugui couldn't bear the temptation of the fragrance and spoke very matter-of-factly.
As he spoke, he took out a silver ingot from his arms and handed it to Luochen.
The silver ingot weighs five taels, enough to buy a cow.
"One chicken and one silver ingot, only two are sold."
Luochen looked at Yin Yuanbao and finally spoke.
There are only a few copper plates in the backpack, so it would be good to exchange for some silver coins. We are still a month away from Lingxiao Sect. With the silver coins, we can buy horses and go faster.
"Okay, okay.
Can you sell the remaining half of the roasted rabbit? I will also give you a gold ingot. "
Li Fugui quickly took out two more ingots.
Luochen silently took the three ingots and handed over two roast chickens and half a roast rabbit.
The smell of roasted chicken was so tempting that Li Fugui opened his mouth to nibble without even caring about burning it.
"It's delicious, delicious, fat but not greasy, and leaves a fragrance on your lips and teeth."
Li Fugui was chewing and praising at the same time. There was meat in his mouth and his words were unclear.
“Prodigal son.
What the hell, I bought two roasted chickens and half a roasted rabbit for only three gold coins. What a waste of money. "
The two bodyguards cursed in their hearts, but did not dare to speak out.
Li Yong was not surprised and ignored Li Fugui's performance.
He looked at the little white snake wrapped around Luochen's arm with interest.
“Although the level cannot be seen, this little white snake is definitely a spiritual beast.
It is not easy for people who can bring spiritual pets. "
Li Yong thought to himself.
He once practiced in a small sect, but his spiritual roots were too complicated and he made no progress for many years after practicing the first level of qi. He was sent down the mountain to help the sect in business.
Although he is only at the first level of Qi Refining, he is still very discerning.
Li Fugui devoured a roast chicken and noticed the little white snake.
"Brother, sell this little snake to me. I'll give you five gold coins, no, ten gold coins."
"I won't sell it, no matter how much money I have!"
Luochen was a little angry and refused.
The little white snake seemed to understand the conversation. He raised his head and glared at Li Fugui with a fierce look in his eyes.
"Little brother, I would like to take the liberty to ask, are you from the sect?"
Li Yong wanted to ease the awkward atmosphere.
"No, I still want to find the sect."
Luochen replied subconsciously.
"If you are looking for a sect, go to Lingxiao Sect. It is a big sect and will recruit new disciples in a month.
I'm just going to take the assessment, how about we go together? I'll cover all your room and board expenses. "
Before Li Yong could speak, Li Fugui spoke first.
